title: OmniNWM: Omniscient Driving Navigation World Models

output_modality.value: panoramic videos of RGB, semantics and metric depth, jointly generated, lifted to 3D semantic occupancy

control_signal.value: Ego trajectory actions encoded as normalized panoramic Plücker ray-maps; the VLA planner's output trajectory also steers generation in the closed loop

control_mechanism.value: Canonical ray-maps and reference frames given as conditions C to a panoramic diffusion transformer; denoising on a joint latent of channel-concatenated RGB, semantics and depth

base_model.value: Panoramic Diffusion Transformer (PDiT) trained with rectified flow matching, on latents from a pretrained 3D VAE; occupancy lifter and OmniNWM-VLA planner as extra modules

datasets.value: Trained on nuScenes and nuScenes-Occupancy; zero-shot tests on nuPlan and in-house datasets with different camera rigs

metrics.value: FID, FVD, RotErr, TransErr, VelErr, AccErr, occupancy IoU and mIoU, depth Abs. Rel., Scenario Pass Rate and collision rate

controllability_evidence.value: Camera-control error on 150 nuScenes validation scenes: 1.18 m TransErr versus 7.56 m for UniScene; zero-shot nuPlan TransErr 1.65 versus 7.12 for DiST-4D

closed_loop.value: Yes: planners including OmniNWM-VLA evaluated closed loop on 150 nuScenes validation scenes at 12 Hz, best Scenario Pass Rate 87.3%; generation lengths up to 321 frames listed

notes: Table 3 shows two OmniNWM rows with an unclear distinguishing marker in the packet. FID 5.45 and FVD 23.63 at 224x400, 17 frames. Occupancy mIoU 19.8.
